newsitem.title: INDIA: India says to import two mln tonnes wheat in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: India says to import two mln tonnes wheat in 97/98.

text.p: India will import a total of two million tonnes of wheat in fiscal 1997/98 (April-March), a senior government official said on Wednesday.

"The government was compelled to import wheat to meet domestic demand, and another two million tonnes will be imported," a Agriculture Ministry statement quoted Cabinet Secretary T.S.R. Subramaniam as saying at a closed-door meeting of state officials.
Subramaniam did not say if the two million tonnes of imports would be in addition to the 2.75 million tonnes of wheat already contracted by the State Trading Corporation (STC) since December 1996.
Officials could not be reached for clarification.
India had authorised STC to import wheat in December to augment stocks and stabilise domestic prices.
